title: NSP Post-Matric Scholarship intake fields (demo scope)
description: Field names, types and formats match the real National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) Post-Matric application: State of Domicile, Personal Details, Bank Account Details sections. Scoped to the fields named in idea-spec.md for the 90 second demo; the full NSP form has additional academic/institution fields not covered here.

applicant_name.description: Full name of student, as printed on educational certificates

date_of_birth.description: DD-MM-YYYY, matching NSP's required certificate format

state_of_domicile.description: State of permanent address, per NSP terminology

bank_account_number.description: Applicant's own bank account, required for DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer)
